description: Values of the 2026 scoring that are not functions of the daily statistics: the P95 cut-off of the regional high-level stratum (from persistence values), China fallback replacement counts (from the history array), and the disturbed-day classification counts (from hourly OMNI2 Kp/Dst).

disturbance.cadence: all 24 hourly OMNI2 records per target UTC day
disturbance.version: Kp: OMNI2/GFZ, final status not separately declared; Dst: January–July provisional, August–October 29 quick-look; October 30 version not independently confirmed
disturbance.rule: any hourly Kp>=5 or Dst<=-50; any missing Kp/Dst hour excludes date only from this stratum

china_2026.P95_support: all finite common causal P grid-times, without future target mask

japan_2026.P95_support: all finite common causal P grid-times, without future target mask
